newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MAS to hold news conference on Sunday.
newsitem.headline: MAS to hold news conference on Sunday.

text.p: Malaysia Airline System Bhd (MAS) said on Saturday that it was calling for a news conference on Sunday to announce the "latest development" within the company.
In a statement, the national carrier said its chairman Tajudin Ramli will chair the meeting at 1000 local time (0200 GMT) at its headquarters.
Analysts said the company may be set to announce an expected restructuring which could involve its management team and its subsidiaries.
The restructuring may also involve another Tajudin-controlled firm, Technology Resources Industries Bhd (TRI), some analysts said.
Others said the company may be announcing a rights issue to help fund the purchase of its new aircraft.
MAS last year said it was buying 25 aircraft from Boeing at a cost of 10 billion ringgit.
"They have to finance a lot of planes. There could be a management restructuring too," said an analyst at a European research house.
A company spokesman declined to comment on the reason for the news conference.
